docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WATSON, CALVIN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY $354.52 PRINCIPAL, $45.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $399.52, DEFAULT JUDGMENT AMOUNT IS TO REFUND AS COMCAST SERVICE ENDED BY MAY 01, 2019. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $354.00 FILED BY WATSON, CALVIN AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2019 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF WATSON, CALVIN AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED MAY-31-2019, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY
STIPULATION FOR CASE TO BE HEARD BY JUDGE PRO TEM. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.) FILED BY WATSON, CALVIN

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-01-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-01-2019 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU. PLAINTIFF CALVIN WATSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT COMCAST COMPANY IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
